strings.Tarayıcınızda çalışan basit ve hızlı bir: A simple, fast photo editor that runs in your browser.

strings.Tıkladığınız alan seçili renkle doldurul: The area you click is filled with the selected color. If a drawing layer is selected, the fill goes onto it; otherwise a new layer is added so the photo stays intact.
strings.Tıklanan renge ne kadar benzeyen alanın: How similar an area must be to the clicked color to be filled. A low value fills only the same color; a high value also fills similar shades.
strings.Tıklayarak benzer renkli alanı kaldırın;: Click to remove an area of similar color; Shift + click restores. With "Connected area only" off, similar colors anywhere in the image are selected.
Click to remove a similarly colored area. Shift + click brings it back.
